notes.title: Demo 0.4: Artist found!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224373/bb7dcac02402125bbf443ca982491ef749a7dd06.jpg[/img]

This updates brings:
[list]
[*] Finally new amazing artwork for the characters by [url=https://linktr.ee/bsec]rallyvince[/url] 
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]

Also I updated the description of the store page with more story and lore explanation.
I have some [i]plans[/i] to update the trailer and the screenshots as well. But not sure If I can do a new trailer, because the previous one took me a couple of months to make ːcozycastondeathː

notes.title: Demo: v0.3 Navigation fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42224373/76bc74ac607328300293b982f07300a55073048c.png[/img]
Finally added a navigation pointer. Took me a bit, due to some personal issues

Fixes:
* Added a navigation objective in the compass area
* Fixed the "wave" attack that spawns on the second boss, when the player just re-spawned
* Small fixes
